name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2021-02-15.236.1) moved by West Australian Senator [Louise Pratt](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/wa/louise_pratt) (Labor), which means they failed. The amendments related to: * an advance payment scheme for elderly and ill applicants; * a funders of last resort guarantee; * psychological counselling and support; * better recognising the impact of sexual abuse; and * requiring non -participating institutions to contribute to scheme.
